head: af654561e2f883f086fd694abede433abfffff6b
title: Fixed toggle cards losing rich content when imported from HTML
body:
Fixes https://github.com/TryGhost/Ghost/issues/32428

Importing a toggle card from HTML reads its heading and body with `textContent`, dropping link destinations, emphasis and paragraph boundaries. Reading `innerHTML` preserves the HTML fields expected by the editor and renderer. Includes a patch changeset for `@tryghost/kg-default-nodes`.

Validation:
- The rich-content regression failed before the fix. After the fix, all 16 tests in `toggle.test.ts` and 37 in `html-to-lexical.test.ts` passed with Node 22.23.4/Vitest 4.1.12 (isolated sandbox, one worker). Coverage includes escaped characters, plain content and render → import → render.
- Commit hooks passed: formatting, both package ESLint checks, staged-file scanning and changeset validation.
- `pnpm check` stopped at global formatting (4,763 files reported, mostly outside this diff), so it did not reach full lint/tests. The changed converter test was subsequently formatted by the passing commit hook. The broad Koenig suite was stopped for runtime; only the focused results above are claimed.

[Reproduction and validation details](https://github.com/JoaoMarcos44/Ghost/blob/e2433b625dc9f4776ecbf3dec55e7ca4c2f7849f/reports/ghost-prs-2026-10-31/toggle/evidence.md) · [Visual explanation](https://github.com/JoaoMarcos44/Ghost/blob/e2433b625dc9f4776ecbf3dec55e7ca4c2f7849f/reports/ghost-prs-2026-10-31/toggle/infographic_report.md)

<details>
<summary>Infographic — editorial print</summary>

![Preserving rich toggle content through HTML conversion](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/JoaoMarcos44/Ghost/e2433b625dc9f4776ecbf3dec55e7ca4c2f7849f/reports/ghost-prs-2026-10-31/toggle/infographic.png)

</details>

- [x] I've read and followed the [Contributor Guide](https://github.com/TryGhost/Ghost/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] I've explained my change
- [x] I've written an automated test to prove my change works

Draft while repository-wide validation remains outstanding.
